tools.name: citation_tracker_check_perplexity
tools.description: Sends one prompt to Perplexity (sonar) and reports whether it cites your target domains, with citation count and cited domains. Free: 5 calls per caller and 200 calls total per UTC day; both limits fail closed.

tools.name: citation_tracker_monitor_status
tools.description: Reads an existing monitor: remaining runs, next run time, and runs so far with changes per target domain. Needs the monitor_id.

tools.name: citation_tracker_monitor_cancel
tools.description: Stops an existing monitor and deletes its prompt, domains and results. Needs the monitor_id.
